newsitem.title: RWANDA: First of tide of refugees cross from Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: First of tide of refugees cross from Tanzania.

text.p: Rwandan refugees at the head of a column said by the U.N. refugee agency to number hundreds of thousands began crossing into Rwanda from Tanzania on Saturday, witnesses said.
A Reuters correspondent watched the first 150 people cross at the Rusomo border as a much larger group of people headed down the hill to the border.

Tanzanian troops had ordered all foreign journalists from the Rusomo crossing. U.N. officials said the frontier would stay open beyond a normal closing time of 6 p.m. (1500 GMT) to allow refugees to cross to the country which they fled in 1994.

Judith Melby, a spokeswoman for the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), estimated hundreds of thousands of Rwandan refugees were moving towards the border from as far away as Nyakahura, over 100 km (65 miles) from the border.
